plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Teltonika router. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, temperature, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 48690).
name: Router

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of the Teltonika cellular router as a 0-100 percentage, from the private cpuUsage scalar (GET with instance .0). Sustained high CPU usage can indicate control-plane overload or abnormal traffic.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total physical memory of the Teltonika cellular router in bytes (UCD memTotalReal scalar, KB×1024).

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Available physical memory of the Teltonika cellular router in bytes (UCD memAvailReal scalar, KB×1024).

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Used physical memory of the Teltonika cellular router in bytes (UCD memTotalReal − memAvailReal scalars, KB×1024).

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilization of the Teltonika cellular router, derived as 100×(total−free)/total from the UCD memTotalReal and memAvailReal scalars.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Modem temperature of the Teltonika cellular router in degrees Celsius. mTemperature reports tenths of a degree and is divided by 10 at collection so stored values, dashboards and alerts are already in °C. High values can indicate enclosure heat buildup or modem thermal stress.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
